description: Given to the town of Loudes in 1994 by defence minister Francois Leotard and put on its plinth in 1996 after 24 years of service; the airframe had flown with the Patrouille de France flying school. Vandalised and left to decay, it was taken down in 2024, restored for about 20,000 euros by a local firm and put back on the plinth on 27 March 2025 in Patrouille de France blue-white-red, with surveillance cameras added. Serial not published by the town, so tail_number is blank.
